vBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2311: strike-PR / UAT-batch merges don't reconcile per-issue record (mergeStatus/labels/branches) + merge-fulfillment verifier

plan.title: Reconcile per-issue record on strike-PR / UAT-batch merges + merge-fulfillment verifier
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: 18 done/closed issues carry pipeline.mergeStatus=pending and lack merged/closed-out labels despite their work being genuinely on main. Root cause (verified): on-merge reconciliation is keyed on the member issue's OWN feature/<id> PR. Strike PRs work on strike/<id> — the merge webhook's issueIdFromBranch (webhook-handlers.ts:48-51) matches only feature/ so merged strike PRs are dropped. UAT-batch members reach main via the aggregate uat/<codename> merge commit while their own PR stays open — firePostMergeLifecycle IS called per member but verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle (merge-agent.ts:277) rejects them (allowVerifiedNoPrMerge only covers the no-PR case). The empty review_status table is by design (PAN-1983); the per-issue read door self-heals from the record, but the record itself says pending.
narratives.Proposal: Close each gap at its branch-shape source: (1) widen issueIdFromBranch so the existing merge webhook recognizes strike/<id> and mark reviewStatus=passed for strikes; (2) thread a code-level 'already on main' signal (member.headSha/branch ancestor of origin/main) through the UAT per-member fan-out so postMergeLifecycle reconciles each member; (3) a new merge-fulfillment verifier that decides merged|stranded from code-level evidence only (PR merged state and/or git merge-base --is-ancestor), never git log --grep; (4) a lean reconcile action that finishes record/label/branch bookkeeping for already-done issues without resurrecting them; (5) a pan admin db reconcile-merges backfill that reconciles the drift set and flags stranded issues.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Read-door done->merged reconciliation in issue-data-service.ts (that is PAN-2310).
- Repopulating the review_status SQLite table on boot (working-as-designed; the read door self-heals).
- Fixing the roles/strike.md vs buildStrikePrompt who-merges contradiction (separate prompt-hygiene issue).
- Reworking postMergeLifecycle's deploy hop, session teardown, or the close-out ceremony.
- Any change to the standard feature/<id> merge path's existing working reconciliation.

autoDecisions.summary: Empty review_status table is working-as-designed; no boot-time repopulation added.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-1983 makes the SQLite table a rebuildable cache with no boot seed; getReviewStatusSync self-heals from the record pipeline block. Adding a boot seed would duplicate a source of truth and contradict the single-source-of-truth tenet. The defect is upstream in the records, which the merge-completion fixes and backfill address.

autoDecisions.summary: Reconcile action is lean (setReviewStatusSync + labels + guarded branch delete), NOT full postMergeLifecycle, for the backfill of already-done issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: postMergeLifecycle's terminal-guard short-circuits completed specs and its remaining steps (verifying_on_main transition, deploy hop) would wrongly resurrect a closed issue. A dedicated close-out-shaped reconcile is safer and idempotent.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Real merge' is defined by PR merged state and/or git merge-base --is-ancestor, never git log --grep.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue explicitly warns a grep matches incidental chore(records)/docs mentions. Branch containment and PR merged state are authoritative code-level signals and reuse the existing verifyStrikeBranchMergedIntoMain pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: New CLI verb lives at pan admin db reconcile-merges.
autoDecisions.rationale: db.ts registers under the admin group; the adjacent backfill/restore verbs (backfill-records, restore-verdicts) live there, and no wrapper skill exists so there is no skills<->CLI lockstep cost.

items.title: Recognize merged strike/<id> PRs in the merge webhook and mark reviewStatus=passed

expected_outputs: webhook-handlers test passes including strike-branch cases

narrative.Action: Widen issueIdFromBranch (src/lib/webhook-handlers.ts:48-51) from /feature\/([a-z]+-\d+)$/i to /(?:feature|strike)\/([a-z]+-\d+)$/i so all callers recognize strike refs; the existing closed+merged dispatch (webhook-handlers.ts:388-402) then fires postMergeLifecycle(issueId, projectPath, pr.head.ref). Add an optional markReviewPassed?: boolean param to postMergeLifecycle (src/lib/cloister/merge-agent.ts:319) that folds reviewStatus:'passed' into the setReviewStatusSync call at merge-agent.ts:370. In the webhook dispatch, pass markReviewPassed = pr.head.ref.startsWith('strike/'). Also pass markReviewPassed:true from the pan done --strike handoff (src/cli/commands/done.ts:493). Verify the other 6 issueIdFromBranch callers (webhook-handlers.ts:296,340,476,510,580) behave correctly for strike refs (recognizing the issue is correct in all).

items.title: Given a ref 'strike/pan-123', issueIdFromBranch returns 'PAN-123'; given 'feature/pan-123' it still returns 'PAN-123'; given 'main' or 'uat/pan-slate-0625' it returns null
When a closed+merged pull_request webhook arrives with head.ref 'strike/pan-123', the handler dispatches postMergeLifecycle with that branch ref (asserted via a spy/mock)
postMergeLifecycle called with markReviewPassed:true persists reviewStatus='passed' in the same setReviewStatusSync write that persists mergeStatus='merged'
The new markReviewPassed param is optional and defaults to no-op: postMergeLifecycle preserves its PAN-328 single-flight behavior, so a second concurrent call for the same issue exits as a no-op
Accept batch-merged UAT members in the merge oracle via a code-level ancestor check

expected_outputs: uat-promote test passes including the batch-member reconciliation case

narrative.Action: Add an optional verifiedMergedRef?: string param to postMergeLifecycle (merge-agent.ts:319) and forward it to verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle (merge-agent.ts:277-317). When set, the oracle additionally accepts the issue as merged if `git merge-base --is-ancestor <verifiedMergedRef> origin/main` succeeds (async execAsync), even when the member's own PR (gh pr list --head feature/<id>) is still open — this closes the open-PR gap that allowVerifiedNoPrMerge (no-PR-only) does not. Give firePostMergeLifecycle (src/dashboard/server/routes/specialists/shared.ts:129) an optional opts arg and forward it to postMergeLifecycle. At the UAT fan-out (src/lib/cloister/uat-promote.ts:186-189) pass each member's headSha (preferred) or branch as verifiedMergedRef. Preserve existing skipDeploy behavior for batch members.

items.title: verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle returns merged:true for an issue whose own feature/<id> PR is open when verifiedMergedRef resolves as an ancestor of origin/main
verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle still returns merged:false when verifiedMergedRef is NOT an ancestor of origin/main and no merged PR exists (a member whose commits did not actually land is refused)
After promoteUatGeneration completes, setReviewStatusSync runs for every member and persists pipeline.mergeStatus='merged' to each member's per-issue record
firePostMergeLifecycle accepts an optional opts arg and forwards it to postMergeLifecycle, and preserves the behavior of its existing no-arg callers (webhook, merge-ops)
Code-level merge-fulfillment verifier returning merged|stranded|unknown

expected_outputs: merge-fulfillment test passes including the incidental-mention case

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/pan-dir/merge-fulfillment.ts exporting async verifyIssueMergeFulfillment(issueId, project): { verdict: 'merged'|'stranded'|'unknown'; evidence: string }. Read the per-issue record for prUrl/prNumber. Evidence checks (code-level only, async exec): (a) if a tracked PR number/url exists, resolve its merged state via gh pr view (or getPullRequestState when the GitHub App is configured); (b) for each of feature/<id> and strike/<id> that exists (git rev-parse --verify), run `git merge-base --is-ancestor <branch> origin/main`, mirroring verifyStrikeBranchMergedIntoMain (src/cli/commands/done.ts:336-358). verdict='merged' when the PR reports merged OR any branch is contained; verdict='stranded' when a branch exists but is not contained and no PR is merged; verdict='unknown' when nothing can be resolved (non-GitHub, no branch, API/git error). NEVER use git log --grep. Inject the exec/gh helpers so tests can stub them.

items.title: Returns verdict='merged' with branch evidence when git merge-base --is-ancestor feature/<id> (or strike/<id>) origin/main succeeds
Returns verdict='merged' with PR evidence when the record's tracked PR reports a merged state
Returns verdict='stranded' when the issue's branch exists but is NOT an ancestor of origin/main and no merged PR is found
A commit whose subject only mentions the id (e.g. 'chore(records): update PAN-123') does NOT by itself yield 'merged' — the verifier consults branch-ancestry/PR state, not git log --grep
Lean reconcile action: record fields + merged/closed-out labels + guarded branch cleanup

expected_outputs: reconcile-action test passes including the uncontained-branch-preserved case

narrative.Action: In src/lib/pan-dir/merge-fulfillment.ts (or sibling merge-reconcile.ts) export async reconcileMergedIssue(issueId, project, opts?: { closed?: boolean; dryRun?: boolean }). Steps: (1) setReviewStatusSync(issueId, { mergeStatus:'merged', reviewStatus:'passed', readyForMerge:false }) — the write door that updates the record pipeline block + SQLite cache; (2) apply the 'merged' label and, when the tracker issue is closed, the 'closed-out' label plus strip workflow labels — reuse cleanupMergedLabels (src/lib/lifecycle/label-cleanup.ts) and the close-out label constants (src/lib/close-out.ts); (3) for each of feature/<id> and strike/<id>, delete the branch (local + remote) ONLY when `git merge-base --is-ancestor <branch> origin/main` succeeds. Do NOT call postMergeLifecycle (avoids resurrecting closed issues into verifying_on_main). Idempotent: skip the write when the record already reads merged. Honor dryRun by returning the planned actions without writing.

items.title: Persists pipeline.mergeStatus='merged' and reviewStatus='passed' to the per-issue record via setReviewStatusSync
Applies the 'merged' label, and additionally the 'closed-out' label when opts.closed is true
Deletes feature/<id> and strike/<id> only when contained in origin/main; leaves an uncontained branch intact (never deletes unmerged work)
Re-running on an already-merged record performs no record write (idempotent no-op) and dryRun returns planned actions without writing
pan admin db reconcile-merges — backfill verifier over the drift set

expected_outputs: lint passes (no skills drift for admin db)

narrative.Action: Add reconcileMergeFulfillment(options: { issueId?: string; dryRun?: boolean; verbose?: boolean }) to the merge-fulfillment module: enumerate done/closed issues whose record pipeline.mergeStatus != 'merged' (reuse collectInFlightIssueIds / record enumeration; or a single options.issueId), then per issue run verifyIssueMergeFulfillment — 'merged' => reconcileMergedIssue (or report under dryRun); 'stranded'/'unknown' => record it in the result and print a flagged line, never reconcile. Register the subcommand in src/cli/commands/db.ts alongside restore-verdicts: db.command('reconcile-merges') with --issue-id <id>, --dry-run, --verbose, a spinner, and a summary line (reconciled / stranded / unknown / skipped). No skills wrapper exists for admin db subcommands — confirm none and make no skills/ change.

items.title: With --dry-run, reconcile-merges reports which drift issues would be reconciled and which are stranded, and writes no records
For an issue the verifier confirms merged, the command persists pipeline.mergeStatus='merged' to its record
For a stranded issue (branch exists, not contained in origin/main, no merged PR), the command prints a flagged line and does NOT set mergeStatus='merged'
--issue-id <id> processes exactly one issue and emits a summary reporting one processed issue
